configuration.incumbent_pruning_policy: probe at N_best, permit one probe at ceil(2*N_best), then heuristically prune only if no feasible observation exists
configuration.numeric_sampling_safety_policy: runtime-derived min(NumPy intp max, C-long max) before learner

state_identity.raw_digest_caveat: Exact seeds, ledger, encoder configuration, and partition match; two regenerations differ by at most the recorded floating last bits.

early_fidelity_semantics.semantics: operational AND mean_error_feasible only for S=1,2,4,8

projected_full_256_cost.method: first-order linear scaling of observed 16-candidate work by 16
projected_full_256_cost.precision_note: diagnostic estimate only; progressive reuse can change scaling
